headline_indicator: tCO2e of greenhouse gas emissions avoided
description: Emissions avoided through clean energy generation and building energy savings in the reporting period.
boundaries: Calendar 2025 or most recent 12-month period ending in 2025; actuals only; forecasts excluded; MWh not converted to tCO2e where the organization already reports tCO2e for the same activity.
external_alignment: IRIS+ GHG emissions avoided metrics (verify exact metric ID); SDG 13

headline_indicator: MWh of clean energy generated or saved
description: Clean electricity generated plus energy saved through retrofits.
boundaries: Same time boundary as H1; actuals only.
external_alignment: SDG indicator 7.2.1 (renewable share of energy) - population-level percentage

description: People living in below-market rental units financed by the portfolio.
boundaries: Most recent 12-month period ending in 2025; households converted to people using a documented proxy.

description: Ongoing full-time and part-time jobs at portfolio organizations and their financed businesses.
boundaries: Includes permanent full-time and part-time roles; excludes temporary construction roles and volunteer hours; investee-level data preferred over fund totals; cross-holdings deducted.
external_alignment: IRIS+ jobs metrics (verify exact metric ID); SDG target 8.5

headline_indicator: People who gained employment after training
description: Training completers employed within six months.
boundaries: Outcome-level only; activity metrics such as training hours excluded; rounded down to whole people.

headline_indicator: People with recurring access to nutritious food
description: Unique people receiving recurring food support.
boundaries: Excludes one-time emergency support and event attendance.
